thread:
maria: Follow-up from RFC review: proposal to shrink the inference-config hotspot by extracting policy evaluation into a dedicated policy-plane. Aim: simplify runtime branching and make contract minimal.
aj: Makes sense. What's the least risky rollout path?
maria: Phased: 1) deploy read-only policy-plane API, 2) snapshot+CDC backfill, 3) sidecar shim for legacy adapters, 4) route a small shard set to policy-plane, 5) ramp and retire shims.
simon: For the snapshot/CDC, can we use a read-replica to avoid locks?
maria: Yes — snapshot from replica at T0. Backfill SQL: 
```sql
INSERT INTO policy_plane.policies (id, cfg, updated_at)
SELECT id, cfg, updated_at FROM replica.inference_policies WHERE updated_at <= :T0;
```
Then Kafka consumer for deltas.
katie: How to limit blast radius by tenant?
simon: Router will add header `x-policy-plane=on` for selected tenant shards. Envoy picks this up and routes to policy-plane. Start with 5% shards.
aj: What about writes during cutover? We need a single source of truth.
maria: New policy service is authoritative. We'll reject direct writes to legacy store after Tcut and route writes through an adapter that writes new store + emits CDC if backward sync needed. No dual-authority.
katie: Monitoring and SLO gates?
maria: Alerts: policy_plane_5xx > 0.2% sustained 5m, p95 latency delta > 30ms for 10m, adapter.sidecar_fallback_rate > 1% for 10m. Create a synthetic probe per canary tenant hitting a representative path every 30s.
infra-bot: deploy checklist: create envoy filter `policy-plane-route`, add k8s canary for router, schedule DB snapshot on low traffic window. Recommend using `kubectl rollout status` and a staged replica set.
simon: Rollback plan? revert envoy filter and route back to legacy, disable sidecars. Also have a circuit that falls back to legacy on policy-plane errors.
aj: Tests before any canary: unit contract lints, integration with sidecar, load test at expected QPS, chaos test that kills sidecar.
maria: We'll also include a compatibility shim mapping policy_v1 -> policy_v2 for a 6-week window to avoid breaking adapters. Post-cutover, run audit ticket INF-7722 to prune old adapters.
katie: Owners and timeline?
maria: Owners: maria (arch), aj (runtime), simon (router), infra (ops). Timeline: spike this sprint, infra canary next week, ramp 3 weeks, full cut month+1.
simon: I'll own the envoy changes and shard mapping.
katie: I'll build dashboards and the runbook. Sync tomorrow 9:30 for dry-run.
maria: I'll update the RFC with scripts, SQL, and alert rules. Thanks. :rocket:
